hook_line: ANJALI SUD TO LEAD SIRIUSXM AS CEO

Sud takes over as CEO on January 1

diaspora_bullets: Indian-origin executive named to lead the largest US satellite radio company
news_summary: SiriusXM has appointed Anjali Sud, the Indian-origin executive who leads Fox's streaming service Tubi, as its next chief executive, effective January 1, 2027, succeeding Jennifer Witz.
payoff: Her task: convert streaming and podcast assets into growth.
